title: tab hoarder
pitch: stack browser tabs on a tired computer. perfect drops stack a multiplier. free_ram_download.exe is a trap.
controls: tap / click / space to drop. m mutes, p pauses, s shares on the result card.
changelog: v2.4: career between runs (rank from lifetime tabs, 15 goals that unlock 4 tab skins, a daily height with a streak), your-best and daily height lines on the stack, one free miss before tab 10, first-run tap hint, big banners, hub autostart, quiet results card. v2.2: alignment guides show the stack edges and light up in the perfect window, shorter how-to on the title. v2: points with a perfect-streak multiplier (up to 5x), width regrow, 5 power-up tabs (perfect = double), lag spikes late, share card, mute/pause/cc hooks, slider kept on screen, thin-tab and restart fixes.
